content: संबन्धिन् {%a.%} .²1 Relating or belonging to. .²2 Connected with, serving as an adjunct, inherent. .²3 Possessing good qualities. --{%m.%} .²1 A relation by marriage; एष वः श्लाघ्यसंबन्धी जनकानां कुलोद्वहः <ls>U. 4. 9</ls>. .²2 A relation, kinsman (in general); संबन्धिनो वसिष्टादीनेष तातस्तवार्चति <ls>U. 1. 16</ls>; <ls>R. 2. 38</ls>. .{@-शब्दः@} an expression which gains its currency owing to the relationship existing between two persons or things; पत्नीति संबन्धिशब्दोऽयम् <ls>ŚB. on MS. 6. 1. 7</ls>.
